title: German Quesadilla Bratwurst
description: A twist on traditional German bratwurst, wrapped in a crispy tortilla with melted cheese and savory spices.
instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet to medium-high heat.
2. Add the Bratwurst sausages to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, mix the shredded cheese with the Turkish pepper and set aside.
4. Place a large tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with the cheese mixture.
5. Add a cooked Bratwurst sausage on half of the tortilla, leaving a small border around the edges.
6. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the sausage.
7. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
8. Repeat with the remaining sausages and tortillas.
9. Serve hot with a side of QQ Caramelized Onions and a dollop of Bouncy Beer-infused sour cream (if using).
10. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
